title: Gearbug Garden
pitch: Wind through a clockwork hedge maze, gather every golden cog while topiary beasts roam, then slip out the brass gate.
style: whimsical steampunk garden, stylised low-poly, warm soft light

enemy.describe: a wandering topiary hedge monster with leafy teeth and stubby legs

goal.describe: a tall ornate brass garden gate

player.describe: a small brass clockwork beetle with a wind-up key on its back

wall.describe: a square block of neatly trimmed green boxwood hedge
